premises.text: Hospital value is mostly an administrative layer (registration, billing, shared records) that technology can replace so care can be delivered as a connected platform rather than buildings
premises.evidence_span: you can replace most of these things with technology

premises.text: Carbon Health is a patient-and-physician technology platform spanning easy insurance onboarding, condition-organized records, messaging, real charts, and actionable care tasks
premises.evidence_span: a ubiquitous technology platform that connects us with our doctors

premises.text: Care is a seamless hybrid of virtual and in-person visits with automated history-aware intake, clinic handoff with full context, and optional virtual follow-ups
premises.evidence_span: a seamless hybrid of virtual and in-person care

premises.text: Launch via a pilot primary-care clinic in San Francisco, then extend the platform to independent practices nationwide
premises.evidence_span: we are opening Carbon in our pilot primary care clinic in San Francisco
